utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Welcome everybody.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Today is Monday, October 7th. We have a special meeting. It's 4pm of the Samwell City Council. I'll request the City Clerk to call the roll.

utterances.speaker: C
utterances.text: Vice Mayor Hill?

utterances.speaker: D
utterances.text: Present.

utterances.text: Council member Kurtz? Present.

utterances.speaker: E
utterances.text: Three of us here.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Should we take public comment or should.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: We have a discussion around the planning commission interviews? As I understand we had another person.

utterances.speaker: E
utterances.text: Who had a plain delay pla any so they are not here even though they're still interested. And there was another individual who also had a scheduling conflict. So there would only be two people today. So what are our options going forward?

utterances.speaker: C
utterances.text: Yeah, I think first we can discuss the agenda setting and Planning commission should move forward because the City council does have the option to continue it to a future date or hold the interviews today. So we had five applicants in total. Two of them withdrew due to last minute scheduling issues. There is still an interest and they want to apply and be interviewed for the planning commission. And then there was one applicant who withdrew who's not interested in serving in the role. The City Council could have the option of inter holding the interviews for the two remaining applicants today or continuing the interviews for to October 21st or a special meeting that works for everyone as well. We can call a special meeting in addition to this. I just want to point out that the planning commission meeting that's coming up for Northgate is October 29th. So we could hold interviews on October 21st. We have an hour available that I was planning on using for a different border commission. But we could utilize that for the planning commission because I know we do really want to get that the seat this commission up and running.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Okay, so question for you. There are three of us here today. Is it possible to have two interviews.

utterances.speaker: E
utterances.text: Today and then the additional to another time? Or would you recommend that we wait until all five of us are present and then do all the interviews on the 21st which does inconvenience the two applicants that were available today. But we're trying to do what's best for the entire process and for the city.

utterances.speaker: C
utterances.text: I would recommend to have the full city council here for both and have the applicants return on another day. Just so Councilmember Bushy and Council Member Yanez Gulati would be able to participate in that decision. With such an important body. I think that voice, their voices are important as well.

utterances.speaker: E
utterances.text: And I think that was one part of the bylaws. It said when possible that it's. It's one of the boards that has all five.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: C
utterances.text: Thank you for pointing out.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: E
utterances.text: So with massive apology to the two that were available. One was even here in person asking them to come back.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: But I do think that's the right thing.

utterances.speaker: E
utterances.text: These are very, very important seats. We have a lot of important projects coming up, and we want it to.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Be as the pool to be as competitive as possible.

utterances.speaker: D
utterances.text: Do we need a motion to continue?

utterances.speaker: C
utterances.text: Yes. If you could make a motion to continue to a date uncertain, that would be fine. And I'll find a date that works for everyone's schedules, including the applicants as well.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: And just so you know, I mean, the 21st, fine. But if we have to do a special meeting because there's a Monday in.

utterances.speaker: E
utterances.text: Between, whatever 14 added seven today, so that could be another possibility.

utterances.speaker: C
utterances.text: Great. To both of those dates.

utterances.speaker: D
utterances.text: I make a motion to continue the meeting to date.

utterances.speaker: E
utterances.text: Just the interviews.

utterances.speaker: D

First of all, is there any item that you'd like to hold? Not seeing my colleagues wanting to hold any item. I will open up the public comment for this.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: It's.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Would you like to comment on this item.

utterances.speaker: C

utterances.speaker: D
utterances.text: Yes. I would love to thank everybody for the opportunity to. To serve now as I guess you would call it, affirmative position. I know it was a big battle. There were a lot of people. I win because I'm the best.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Very best. Absolutely.

utterances.speaker: D
utterances.text: It's the best. Thank you all. I appreciate it. I look Forward to spending two productive years.

utterances.speaker: B

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Anyone else like to make public comment? Ms. Reese, do you want to make public comment? You raise your hand or unmute. Okay. Not seeing any additional public comment. I will take request a motion on this item, please. I'll make a motion to approve the consent calendar.
